ops.body:
# cci-fix-4 handoff

Successor of cci-fix-3 (handoff ccn doc ecc8031). The brief came through the orca-desk from the release-v3 root.

## Landed

- v0.6.3, yasyf/cc-inbox#28 (squash e221634, release d74781b) fixes three defects the root hit on 0.6.2:
  - `grep` takes `-i` and `--ignore-case`. Matching stays case-insensitive by default, and `--ignore-case=false` matches case exactly.
  - `--since` takes a clock time such as `09:00`, `9:00 AM` or `12:0x PM`, read in local (Pacific) time. It resolves to the latest such instant at or before now, through `importer.ParseClock` and `Clock.Latest`, which reuse the importer's clock parser.
  - `post` takes its text as one positional argument. Two arguments, an argument plus `--text`, or neither fails with an error that names `--text`.
- Installed 0.6.3 everywhere: ~/.local/bin/cci (checksum-verified tarball), daemon com.yasyf.cc-inbox via `cci serve`, /opt/homebrew/bin/cci (cask, plus the hard-link workaround after the first exec hit the syspolicyd stall again), and plugin cc-inbox@cc-inbox 0.6.3.

## Findings

- A GitHub Actions hosted-runner outage on Oct 5 at about 1 PM cancelled jobs with "The job was not acquired by Runner of type hosted even after multiple attempts". `gh run rerun <id> --failed` recovered every one, including the release's publish-tap job.

## Open

None. The worktree is removed.
